title: How ready are Indian schools and edtech services to give privacy notices? A baseline against the DPDP Act and Rules before May 2027
description: Code, coding rules and de-identified results for a readiness baseline of the public privacy notices of 240 sampled Indian school websites and edtech services against the notice and children's-data requirements of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and Rules 2025. Institution names, URLs and saved notice text are deliberately not included; units appear only as random codes.
